descriptions.await_chatbot_control: Await a lifecycle exit event from the control server.
descriptions.capture_brief: Join the Cohere content blocks into the answer text the response composes.
descriptions.capture_query_vector_cohere: Unwrap the single Cohere embedding row into the flat vector the fan-out sends.
descriptions.capture_query_vector_ollama: Present the flat Ollama embedding as the query vector object the fan-out sends.
descriptions.capture_request: Capture the seeded request fields under the shared query_embedding label (GH-635).
descriptions.check_bluf_section: Confirm the brief carries a populated Bottom Line Up Front section.
descriptions.check_cascade_mode: Decide whether this deployment runs the three-pass cascade or the single-fusion collapse.
descriptions.check_conformance: Decide the verdict from the rendered defect list.
descriptions.check_facets: Decide whether this turn carries retrieval facets.
descriptions.check_fused_rerank_order: Decide whether the fusion returned an ordering to apply.
descriptions.check_gaps_section: Confirm the brief carries a populated Gaps section.
descriptions.check_note_chunks: Decide whether the note's own retrieval produced any rows.
descriptions.check_osint_documents: Decide whether the search branch rendered documents this turn.
descriptions.check_osint_dropped: Decide whether the failed search request was dropped by the client's network policy.
descriptions.check_osint_enabled: Decide whether this deployment runs the search branch at all.
descriptions.check_osint_rerank_order: Decide whether the search pass returned an ordering to apply.
descriptions.check_osint_results: Decide whether the search returned any result.
descriptions.check_prior_sources: Decide whether this turn carries the record ids the prior brief cited.
descriptions.check_proposal_1: Decide whether the first proposed search exists.
descriptions.check_proposal_2: Decide whether the second proposed search exists.
descriptions.check_proposal_3: Decide whether the third proposed search exists.
descriptions.check_proposed_tiers: Decide whether the source selection proposed collection tiers.
descriptions.check_proposed_window: Decide whether the selection proposed a reporting window.
descriptions.check_rag_documents: Decide whether the RAG branch rendered documents this turn.
descriptions.check_reader_clearance: Decide whether this turn carries a final-reader clearance ceiling.
descriptions.check_rerank_order: Decide whether the provider returned an ordering to apply.
descriptions.check_revision_requested: Decide whether this turn revises a retained prior draft.
descriptions.check_revision_search: Decide whether this turn is a revision, which is the only turn that searches on its own proposals.
descriptions.check_section_order: Confirm the required sections appear in template order.
descriptions.check_threat_activity_section: Confirm the brief carries a populated Threat Activity section.
descriptions.cohere_rerank_fused: Score the union of both branches against the tasking through the declared rerank operation.
descriptions.cohere_rerank_rag: Score the retrieved candidates against the tasking through the declared rerank operation.
descriptions.cohere_rerank_search: Score the search results against the tasking through the declared rerank operation.
descriptions.collect_conformance_defects: Collect the four check outcomes into one addressable row list.
descriptions.compose_audit_prompt: Compose the judge prompt from the seeded claim and document.
descriptions.compose_audit_response: Wrap the verdict as the /audit response body.
descriptions.compose_chunk_union: Wrap the note's rows and the carried rows as one row array.
descriptions.compose_citations: Wrap the rendered citation objects as one citations array.
descriptions.compose_documents: Wrap the rendered document objects as one documents array.
descriptions.compose_documents_augmented: Wrap the RAG and external document objects as one documents array.
descriptions.compose_documents_osint_only: Wrap the external document objects alone as the documents array.
descriptions.compose_fused_documents: Wrap the fused top-N as the documents array Command composes from.
descriptions.compose_harvest_response: Wrap the harvest outcome as the HTTP reply.
descriptions.compose_joined_chunks: Wrap the joined rows alone as the row array when the turn holds no rows yet.
descriptions.compose_merged_citations: Wrap the admitted internal and exempt external citations for the merge.
descriptions.compose_open_clearance: Compose the open ceiling a turn without a stated reader runs under.
descriptions.compose_prompt: Compose the question and rendered compatible grounding sections.
descriptions.compose_propose_searches_prompt: Compose the message the search proposal reads: the revision instruction and the prior brief.
descriptions.compose_purge_relay_response: Wrap the purge relay outcome as the HTTP reply.
descriptions.compose_read_response: Merge the units' read results into one response body naming the level enforced.
descriptions.compose_response: Compose the answer with complete source selection and query outcome metadata.
descriptions.compose_search_response: Wrap the rendered search results as the /search response body.
descriptions.compose_search_terms_prompt: Compose the prompt that asks the Command model for web search terms.
descriptions.compose_set_clearance: Compose the ceiling object from the request's stated reader rank.
descriptions.compose_source_selection_prompt: Compose the original question and the human-readable declared source catalog.
descriptions.compose_summary_prompt: Compose the summarization prompt from the seeded document.
descriptions.compose_summary_response: Wrap the summary as the /summarize response body.
descriptions.compose_translate_prompt: Render the segments and target language as the translation tool-call prompt.
descriptions.compose_translate_response: Wrap the translations as the HTTP reply.
descriptions.constrain_source_selection: Resolve model-selected names only to matching trusted topology entries.
descriptions.declare_brief_conformant: Declare the brief structurally conformant to the template version.
descriptions.declare_brief_nonconformant: Declare the brief non-conformant with its specific defects.
descriptions.declare_clearance_levels: Declare the ordered clearance set this deployment recognizes.
descriptions.declare_cohere_tier: Record that the Cohere Command tier answered this turn.
descriptions.declare_cohere_tier_choice: Declare the Cohere Command tier as this turn's composition word, deterministically.
descriptions.declare_composition_unreported: Publish no composed identities on a tier that composes without the fused set.
descriptions.declare_conformance_unchecked: Declare the check itself failed, keeping the turn and the draft.
descriptions.declare_default_citations: Compose and validate the empty citations object every turn starts from.
descriptions.declare_fusion_applied: Record that the composed documents are the fused cross-source top-N.
descriptions.declare_fusion_degraded: Record that the fusion did not run to completion, so the reranked RAG branch composed.
descriptions.declare_harvest_question: Declare the harvest query for the derivation and the search to read.
descriptions.declare_leg_absent: Publish an empty status for a response leg this tier does not run.
descriptions.declare_lowest_clearance: Run the turn at the lowest declared level when the context carried none this deployment recognizes.
descriptions.declare_ollama_tier: Record that an Ollama chat word answered this turn.
descriptions.declare_osint_composed: Record that the search branch composed documents into the turn.
descriptions.declare_osint_disabled: Record that this deployment runs with the search branch disabled.
descriptions.declare_osint_dropped: Record that the client's network policy dropped the search request.
descriptions.declare_osint_empty: Record that the search answered with no results, so the turn composed from RAG alone.
descriptions.declare_osint_errored: Record that the search branch failed and the turn composed from RAG alone.
descriptions.declare_osint_rerank_applied: Record that the search rerank ordered the branch's composed documents.
descriptions.declare_osint_rerank_degraded: Record that the search rerank did not order the branch, so the engine order did.
descriptions.declare_osint_rerank_skipped: Record that the search rerank pass was skipped under the single-fusion collapse.
descriptions.declare_prior_read_request: Publish the prior brief's cited record ids as the read request the document read binds.
descriptions.declare_query_model: Put the query embedding model identity into command state.
descriptions.declare_question: Put the tasking text into command state under a provider-neutral name.
descriptions.declare_rag_topology: Declare the ordered trusted RAG topology for this chatbot instance.
descriptions.declare_read_request: Put the seeded read parameters into command state so the fan-out binds them by selector.
descriptions.declare_requested_clearance: Put the clearance the authenticated request context carried into command state.
descriptions.declare_requested_read_clearance: Put the read's seeded level into command state as the candidate for the window lookup.
descriptions.declare_rerank_applied: Record that the composed documents were ordered by the rerank pass.
descriptions.declare_rerank_degraded: Record that the rerank did not order the composed documents, so the fan-out order did.
descriptions.declare_rerank_skipped: Record that the RAG rerank pass was skipped under the single-fusion collapse.
descriptions.declare_revision_question: Fuse the revision instruction with the retained prior draft under the shared chat_message label.
descriptions.declare_search_queries_fallback: Seed the raw question as the one-query fan input (GH-612).
descriptions.declare_search_terms_fallback: Seed the raw question as the search terms when no model derivation ran.
descriptions.derive_search_terms: Ask the Command model for the web search terms the tasking implies.
descriptions.derive_search_terms_via_tool: Propose web search queries through a forced native tool call (GH-612).
descriptions.embed_harvest_result: Embed one web result's text as a search document.
descriptions.embed_query: Embed the incoming chat message once at the embedding provider.
descriptions.embed_query_cohere: Embed the incoming chat message once at the Cohere embeddings operation.
descriptions.flatten_chunks: Flatten each compatible source's parallel id and chunk arrays into one row per retrieved chunk.
descriptions.flatten_citations: Flatten each returned citation into one row per source it names.
descriptions.flatten_merged_citations: Fan the two citation lanes back into one ordered row list.
descriptions.flatten_prior_chunks: Flatten each unit's read into one row per record, in the shape flatten_chunks produces.
descriptions.flatten_search_rows: Flatten the per-query search results into one row set (GH-612).
descriptions.invoke_cohere_command: Compose the command-staff brief with Cohere Command over the retrieved documents.
descriptions.invoke_llm_deep: Answer the question over the composed grounding prompt with a larger model.
descriptions.invoke_llm_fast: Answer the question over the composed grounding prompt with a small fast model.
descriptions.judge_with_cohere: Score the claim against its document with the Cohere classifier tier.
descriptions.launch_chat_requests: Launch the machine_request chat server that serves a turn.
descriptions.launch_chatbot_control: Launch the control server for health and lifecycle exit.
descriptions.launch_monitor_rest: Launch read-only REST endpoints for cached monitor state.
descriptions.marshal_fused_candidates: Render, wrap, and validate the union documents as the rerank documents array in one word.
descriptions.marshal_harvest_rows: Render the embedded results as the ingest batch and validate it.
descriptions.marshal_osint_candidates: Render, wrap, and validate the search snippets as the rerank documents array in one word.
descriptions.marshal_rag_candidates: Render, wrap, and validate the retrieved chunks as the rerank documents array in one word.
descriptions.osint_search: Query the declared OSINT search endpoint with the analyst's tasking.
descriptions.parse_chunk_union: Parse the joined rows into the object every chunk reader selects items from.
descriptions.parse_citations: Validate the composed citations array into addressable command state.
descriptions.parse_documents: Validate the composed documents array into addressable command state.
descriptions.parse_merged_citations: Validate the merged citation wrapper into command state.
descriptions.parse_proposed_searches: Validate the proposed searches: the declared fields first, second, and third.
descriptions.parse_query_vector: Validate the captured query vector into addressable command state.
descriptions.parse_reader_clearance: Validate the ceiling object under the shared reader_clearance label.
descriptions.parse_source_selection: Parse source-classifier output as a names-only JSON object.
descriptions.parse_tier: Parse the tier-selector response into one chat-LLM tool call.
descriptions.parse_translations: Validate the tool arguments against the translations schema.
descriptions.parse_union_documents: Validate the two branches' composed document union into one addressable array.
descriptions.partition_brief_blocks: Divide the returned content blocks by type, keeping the text blocks.
descriptions.partition_cited_sources: Separate cited sources that resolve to a retrieved document from those that do not.
descriptions.partition_clearance_refusals: Separate sources that refused the requester's clearance from sources that failed.
descriptions.partition_conformance_defects: Separate the named defects from the clean check outcomes.
descriptions.partition_embedding_models: Keep answered sources whose reported embedding model matches the query model.
descriptions.partition_external_citations: Separate external open-source citations from internal ones before the reader filter.
descriptions.partition_harvest_embeds: Keep only the results whose embed succeeded.
descriptions.partition_prior_reads: Keep the units whose read answered with records.
descriptions.partition_query_results: Separate answered RAG queries from rejected or degraded queries.
descriptions.partition_reader_clearance: Separate resolvable cited sources at or below the reader's clearance from those above it.
descriptions.partition_search_results: Keep only search results carrying a non-empty snippet.
descriptions.partition_search_rows: Keep only flattened rows carrying a non-empty snippet (GH-612).
descriptions.project_proposed_ids: List the record ids of the current pass's rows.
descriptions.project_proposed_searches: Project the proposal tool call's arguments, which the parse reads as JSON.
descriptions.project_search_terms: Unwrap the forced tool call's arguments string for schema validation (GH-612).
descriptions.project_tool_arguments: Unwrap the forced tool call's arguments string for schema validation.
descriptions.project_translations: Project the tool call's arguments to one JSON string.
descriptions.propose_searches_via_tool: Ask Command, in one forced tool call, for the retrieval queries the revision needs.
descriptions.publish_analyst_facets: Republish the analyst's facets under the shared retrieval-facets label.
descriptions.publish_proposed_facets: Render the selection's proposed tiers as the retrieval facet filter.
descriptions.publish_windowed_facets: Render the proposed tiers and window as the facet filter.
descriptions.purge_rag_unit: Relay the reset purge to a declared RAG unit's purge surface.
descriptions.rag_ingest: Relay the marshalled batch to a declared RAG unit's ingest surface.
descriptions.rag_query: Query the currently bound RAG source with the message vector.
descriptions.rag_query_faceted: Query the currently bound RAG source with the message vector under the analyst's facet constraints.
descriptions.read_documents: Read the named records from one RAG unit's document boundary.
descriptions.read_documents_by_filter: Read the records matching the caller's filter from one RAG unit's document boundary.
descriptions.record_bluf_defect: Record the missing or unpopulated Bottom Line Up Front section as a defect.
descriptions.record_gaps_defect: Record the missing or unpopulated Gaps section as a defect.
descriptions.record_order_defect: Record the out-of-order required sections as a defect.
descriptions.record_threat_activity_defect: Record the missing or unpopulated Threat Activity section as a defect.
descriptions.relay_export: Forward the approved brief markdown to the exporter and return the rendered PDF.
descriptions.render_analyst_clearance: Render the accepted level as an object the fan-out and the response address by field.
descriptions.render_citations: Render one structured citation object per cited source.
descriptions.render_clearance_refused_sources: Render the clearance-refused sources as reportable entries.
descriptions.render_composed_sources: Render the composed sources as reportable entries.
descriptions.render_composition_ids: Project the composed documents' identities for response metadata.
descriptions.render_conformance_defects: Render the named defects as the verdict's JSON list body.
descriptions.render_documents: Render one Cohere document object per retrieved chunk.
descriptions.render_documents_unranked: Render one Cohere document per retrieved chunk in the order the fan-out returned.
descriptions.render_dropped_citations: Render one entry per cited source the turn could not resolve.
descriptions.render_fused_documents: Render the fused top-N documents for the final composition wrapper.
descriptions.render_grounding: Render model-compatible RAG chunks under their topology names.
descriptions.render_joined_rows: Render the rows being joined as a comma-separated run of row objects.
descriptions.render_model_excluded_sources: Render the embedding-model-excluded sources as reportable entries.
descriptions.render_note_rows: Render the note's own rows as a comma-separated run of row objects.
descriptions.render_osint_documents: Render each search result as a Command document in the RAG candidate shape.
descriptions.render_osint_documents_unranked: Render each search result as a Command document in the order the engine returned.
descriptions.render_query_failed_sources: Render the failed sources as reportable entries.
descriptions.render_read_records: Render each unit's read as the served record shape, keeping the mapped response and dropping the join bookkeeping.
descriptions.render_search_results: Render the retrieved chunks as the search command's result rows.
descriptions.render_withheld_citations: Render one entry per cited source withheld above the reader's clearance.
descriptions.reorder_candidates: Emit the retrieved chunk rows in the order the rerank returned.
descriptions.reorder_fused_documents: Emit the union documents in the order the fusion returned, trimmed to the declared budget.
descriptions.reorder_osint_results: Emit the search results in the order the search rerank returned, trimmed to the declared budget.
descriptions.report_source_selection: Derive declared source names absent from the trusted selected set.
descriptions.resolve_analyst_clearance: Decide whether the context's level is one this deployment declares.
descriptions.search_proposed_query: Run one proposed query through the mesh's own search surface at the requester's clearance.
descriptions.select_all_sources: Select every trusted topology entry as the safe source-router fallback.
descriptions.select_new_prior_ids: Find the cited record ids the note's own retrieval did not already return.
descriptions.select_new_prior_rows: Select one read row for each cited id the note did not retrieve.
descriptions.select_new_proposed_ids: Find the pass's record ids the turn does not already hold.
descriptions.select_new_proposed_rows: Select the pass's rows for the ids the turn does not hold.
descriptions.select_proposal_1: Publish the first proposed search as the query the self search reads.
descriptions.select_proposal_2: Publish the second proposed search as the query the self search reads.
descriptions.select_proposal_3: Publish the third proposed search as the query the self search reads.
descriptions.select_sources: Select declared RAG source names for the original user question.
descriptions.select_sources_via_tool: Select declared RAG source names through a forced native tool call (GH-607).
descriptions.select_tier: Classify the original user question to one chat-LLM word with a small fast model.
descriptions.stop_chat_requests: Stop the owned chat REST listener.
descriptions.stop_monitor_rest: Stop the owned monitor REST listener.
descriptions.summarize_with_cohere: Summarize the composed document with the Cohere Command model.
descriptions.translate_segments_via_tool: Ask the flagship for one translation per segment via the forced tool call.
descriptions.wrap_brief_for_conformance: Wrap the composed brief as a JSON document the structural checks can validate.
descriptions.wrap_source_selection_prompt: Wrap the composed question-and-catalog prompt as the object the tool-call operation selects from.
